primitives.name: JWT Token for NGS Access
primitives.verbatim_quote: `POST api.nfl.com/identity/v3/token` mints a free JWT (roles include ngs_tracking, ngs_advanced_stats, hawkeye_tracking).
primitives.assumptions: Authentication via token grants access to NGS data streams without premium subscription.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Token invalidation or role revocation disables access.

This enables derivation of contextual metrics such as coverage probabilities and interception hazards directly from raw player positions and movement patterns. The participation payload provides structured inputs for modeling pre-snap alignments and route assignments, which are core to tactical analysis. These primitives form a closed-loop system where raw data feeds into a suite of 21 derived metrics, each capturing distinct aspects of game dynamics. The engine's fidelity is validated against live payloads, ensuring reproducibility and reliability. Failure modes include token expiration, missing data fields, or misalignment between expected and actual data formats.
